reviews.author: Josh
reviews.text: CTRL Electrical LLC added a 240 line and breaker to my panel, and hooked it up to my mini split. Price was reasonable and both the owner and the technician were professional and easy to work with. I highly recommend them for any electrical needs, and will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Jim Bleich
reviews.text: Recently needed new kitchen light installed. Ceiling 16' high. Johnathan came quickly and gave me a respectable proposal and quick installation schedule. Mike came next morning and to install new light. Both gentlemen were professional, honest and friendly. I have future electric projects planned and will be calling CTRL again. It was a pleasure speaking and working with a honest team. I contacted another electrician, but $$$ was insanely high and slow schedule. Glad I made this call to Johnathan. As I said I will be calling again and referring then to my neighbors. Thank you.
